function.name: Marketing
function.description: Content, campaigns, experiments and brand monitoring.

jobs.name: Run A/B tests on creative and pick winners
jobs.outcome: Variants of headlines, images or copy are tested on live traffic and the winner is chosen by a stated method.

jobs.name: Draft campaign copy in the brand's voice
jobs.outcome: Copy for a campaign brief arrives in the brand's voice and passes review with light edits.

jobs.name: Monitor and summarize mentions of the brand
jobs.outcome: Mentions across the web and social are collected, classified by sentiment and topic, and summarized daily.

jobs.name: Optimize email creative per recipient
jobs.outcome: Subject lines, images and links vary per recipient and the campaign converts better than the single version.

jobs.name: Optimize a landing page's conversion rate
jobs.outcome: Changes to a landing page are tested and the page converts better than before at a stated confidence.

jobs.name: Personalize email content per segment or recipient
jobs.outcome: Each recipient sees content chosen for them and the campaign outperforms the unpersonalized version.

jobs.name: Publish and maintain a public web presence
jobs.outcome: Pages are written, published and kept current on a site the public reads, without a human in the publish path.
